body: As my instincts took over, I couldn't help but feel an overwhelming urge to protect those innocent footsteps from harm. My heart pounded in my chest as I stepped closer to the fading trail, hoping to catch sight of whoever had left behind these precious marks on the lush green grass. The protective warmth enveloped me like a gentle embrace, urging me to shield them all from whatever darkness lurked out there in the night. Yet simultaneously, a deep-seated fear gripped my soul – their safety was not enough; they were too vulnerable. So with both hands clasped around the soft earth, I whispered reassurances against the ground, "Stay calm, stay together." And then, with a deep breath, I took one last look before turning back towards my own path, knowing that while I would never abandon this group of small creatures, I must always leave them a little further ahead of me.
